The '''Class-4T3 power generator''' was a [[Power generator/Legends|generator]] manufactured by [[Eksoan/Legends|Eksoan]] and used primarily used to power an [[E-Web heavy repeating blaster/Legends|E-Web heavy repeating blaster]].

==Description==
The Class-4T3 power generator was a [[Power generator/Legends|power unit]] that connected to the [[E-Web heavy repeating blaster/Legends|E-Web heavy repeating blaster]] via a three-[[Meter/Legends|meter]] long power conduit that attached to a connector on the underside of the weapon's [[TR-62 Autocushion Tripod/Legends|TR-62 Autocushion Tripod]]. The Class-4T3 was equipped with an advanced [[Gk3 Cryocooler]] [[Cooling unit/Legends|cooling unit]] to prevent it from overheating and causing a potentially fatal overload.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>

While a [[Gunner/Legends|gunner]] fired the weapon, the accompanying Class-4T3 power generator was generally overseen by a second crew member. The crew member's job was to supervise the generator's power flow to the E-Web and adjust it as necessary to prevent an overload. E-Web deployment on the battlefield took about fifteen minutes, especially if the Class-4T3 was "cold"; some [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] crews would attempt to cut down on this set-up time by pre-charging the generators but that left the Class-4T3 more likely to suffer a power surge.<ref name="EGWT" />

The generator could be set to a "preset" mode that allowed a single gunner to operator the weapon without the need for a second crew member. In this mode, the Class-4T3's power flow was keep well within safe operating temperatures but at the cost of reducing the attached E-Web's rate of fire.<ref name="EGWT" />
